items.title: R Environment and Basics
items.description: Set up your R workspace, learn how scripts run, and get comfortable with variables, vectors, and core data types.

items.title: Data Structures and Control Flow
items.description: Organize data with lists, matrices, and data frames, and control the flow of your scripts with conditions and loops.

items.title: Functions and Packages
items.description: Write reusable functions, understand arguments and scope, and extend R with packages.

items.title: Data Cleaning with R
items.description: Handle missing values, fix types, and filter and transform data into analysis-ready shape.

items.title: Visualization and Mini Project
items.description: Turn data into insight with base R plots and ggplot2, then tie everything together in a small analysis project.
